zh.markdown: 前不久抛弃了 token 存在 keyring 的设计，因为这在一些工程做的不太好的系统上可能会有问题。比如通过 ssh 登陆使用，但是目标主机却在桌面弹出了 keyring 的认证和确认信息，导致 `crater auth login` 被卡住。而且我们的 token 本来就能通过浏览器拿到，明文保存这个并不会有特别大的安全风险。

en.markdown: I recently abandoned the design of storing tokens in the keyring, because it can cause problems on systems whose integration is not well implemented. For example, when logging in over SSH, the target machine may display a keyring authentication and confirmation prompt on its desktop, leaving `crater auth login` stuck. Our tokens can already be obtained through the browser, so storing them in plaintext does not introduce a particularly large additional security risk.

zh.markdown: 9 月 24 号腾讯说 QClaw 要在 12 月 24 号停止运营了，只能说情理和预料之中，本来就是一个欠打磨的东西，完全比不过 Codex 远程、Grok Bot 之类的，这俩是我现在用的最多的了。再见捏，企鹅小虾～

en.markdown: On September 24, Tencent said QClaw would shut down on December 24. I can only say that this makes sense and is what I expected: it was an underpolished product to begin with, and it cannot compete with tools such as Codex remote access and Grok Bot, which are the two I use most these days. Bye-bye, little penguin shrimp~

anchor.text: 先说关键结论。经过一段时间的使用，我觉得现在这类 AI review 的 Harness 和模型能力都有待加强，但是绝对是值得使用的，尤其是在代码几乎都是 AI 写的情况下，尤其是在中大型的多开发者/开源项目中，多这样一层上下文与开发环境独立的检查，能够帮助发现不少问题。

zh.markdown: 到现在为止，AI 的静态 review 还是基本上只能检查代码实现的问题，更高层的业务逻辑或者设计之类的还是不太能有效的 review。更好的实现方式可能是让 AI 在检查代码实现的基础上，讲清楚代码设计和逻辑，由人类 reviewer 理解进一步判断是否合理。

anchor.text: Here is the key conclusion first. After using these tools for a while, I think both the harness and the model capability of current AI review tools still need improvement, but they are absolutely worth using. This is especially true when most of the code is already written by AI, and even more so in medium-to-large multi-developer or open-source projects. Adding one extra layer of checking that is independent from the original development context and environment can help catch quite a few problems.

en.markdown: So far, static AI review can mostly only identify problems in code implementation. It still struggles to effectively review higher-level business logic or design. A better approach might be to have AI explain the code design and logic alongside checking the implementation, so that human reviewers can understand them and judge whether they make sense.

zh.markdown: 分发：Done，通过 npm 分发，本来想着用 GitHub Release 快速发布开发版本，但有点麻烦，也没必要，就没做。

en.markdown: Distribution: Done. It is distributed through npm. I originally considered using GitHub Releases to publish development builds quickly, but it was a bit of a hassle and unnecessary, so I did not do it.

zh.markdown: 更新与版本管理：Done，为了避免引入额外的理解困难和歧义，一并统一了整个 Crater 的版本，CLI 也共享这个版本号，由 Tag 正式触发版本构建，开发版本会显示基于对应 Tag 的提交数。

en.markdown: Updates and version management: Done. To avoid adding confusion and ambiguity, I unified versioning across Crater, with the CLI sharing the same version number. Tags trigger release builds, and development versions show the number of commits since the corresponding tag.

zh.markdown: API 版本管理：Done，向前支持几个版本，向后支持几个版本，旧的 API 支持多长时间，还整出 v1、v2 多套 API 这种，对我们来说管理成本太高了。同时为了避免整个软件版本管理的变化，与其解耦，后端和CLI分别记录一个单增的序号，并记录最低支持的对方版本，以此实现握手。主要是作为排除问题的一个方向或者提醒，即使版本不一致也会尽力而为。

en.markdown: API version management: Done. Deciding how many versions to support in either direction, how long to keep old APIs, and maintaining multiple API versions such as v1 and v2 would cost us too much to manage. To keep compatibility checks independent of changes to overall software versioning, the backend and CLI each record a monotonically increasing revision number and the minimum counterpart revision they support, and use these for a handshake. This mainly provides a troubleshooting clue or warning; even when versions do not match, the CLI still makes a best effort.
